description: Agent-based, network-centric simulation of mask-wearing adoption on a multiplex social network with information diffusion, social influence, and policy enforcement starting Day 10. The model is calibrated on Days 0-29 and predicts Days 30-39.

behaviors.name: consume_media
behaviors.description: Agents probabilistically receive information via media and government broadcasts.
behaviors.algorithm: For each agent daily: p_media = lambda_media_daily * MediaChannel.message_intensity * (1 + gov_communication_intensity if day >= mandate_start_day else 1); if not received_info: flip Bernoulli(p_media) to update received_info.

behaviors.name: interact_with_peers
behaviors.description: Agents observe neighbors' mask states and information in each network layer.
behaviors.algorithm: Compute peer_mask_fraction per layer at t-1 over undirected neighbors; optionally rescale effective exposure by mobility_rate and layer weights for influence.

behaviors.name: update_risk_perception
behaviors.description: Minor updates of perceived risk after receiving info.
behaviors.algorithm: If received_info becomes true at t: risk_perception = min(1.0, risk_perception + risk_perception_step).

behaviors.name: decide_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Daily adoption decision via logistic probability with persistence, social influence, received info, and policy pressure.
behaviors.algorithm: Compute logit p = alpha + gamma*risk + sum_l(beta_l * peer_frac_l * layer_modifier(agent)) + delta*received_info + phi*(mask_wearing_{t-1}) + policy_pressure_coef * policy_pressure(agent,t). With probability sigmoid(p) adopt; if adopted at t-1, may drop out with dropout_prob unless policy_pressure>0 or peer_frac high.

behaviors.name: purchase_masks
behaviors.description: If deciding to wear mask and no inventory, attempt purchase given price, budget, availability.
behaviors.algorithm: If target decision = wear and mask_inventory==0: compute affordability = sigmoid(price_elasticity * (retailer_price - mask_cost_mean)); if Retailer.stock_level>0 and budget>=retailer_price and Bernoulli(affordability): purchase min(max_masks_per_purchase, stock_level) and decrement budget, stock.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Information spreads across layers and via media/gov broadcasts.
interactions.effect: Updates Person.received_info based on neighbor info hazards and media/gov signals.

interactions.name: social_peer_influence
interactions.description: Agents observe neighbors’ mask-wearing and adjust adoption probability.
interactions.effect: Computes peer_mask_fraction per layer at t-1 and feeds adoption logistic.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_enforcement
interactions.description: Policy pressure increases adoption propensity and reduces dropout after Day 10.
interactions.effect: Sets policy_pressure per agent per day via mandate_strength, enforcement_probability, trust, pro_social.

interactions.name: supply_and_purchase
interactions.description: Agents purchase masks from retailer subject to stock and price.
interactions.effect: Updates inventory and budget; unsuccessful purchase can prevent adoption.

interactions.name: intra_household_influence
interactions.description: Household members share masks and exert stronger influence.
interactions.effect: Household-level sharing when retailer stock unavailable; family layer influence captured in beta_peer_family.

modules.name: InformationDiffusionEngine
modules.description: Propagates received_info via network layers and exogenous media/government broadcasts.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  if received_info[i] == true: continue
  p_media = lambda_media_daily * (1 + gov_communication_intensity * 1(day >= mandate_start_day))
  p_net = 1 - Π_{l in {family,work,community}} (Π_{j in N_l(i)} [1 - p_info_contact_l * I(received_info[j]==true) * mobility_rate])
  p_total = 1 - (1 - p_media) * (1 - p_net)
  received_info[i] ~ Bernoulli(p_total)
notes: Neighbors N_l(i) are undirected and de-duplicated.
mobility_rate scales effective daily contact probability.
After mandate_start_day, communication intensity boosts only the media/gov hazard via p_media.

modules.calibration_notes: Stage-1 micro calibration via discrete-time survival; in simulation-based calibration, fit p_info_contact_* and lambda_media_daily to match info_rate_daily trajectory (Days 0-29).

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcement
modules.description: Computes daily policy pressure and compliance modulation per agent after mandates.

notes: policy_pressure is a continuous signal added to adoption log-odds via policy_pressure_coef.
trust and pro_social may be sampled from specified distributions if not provided.

modules.calibration_notes: Policy parameters primarily tuned indirectly via adoption fit; no direct intermediate observable provided.

modules.name: SocialAdoptionEngine
modules.description: Determines mask-wearing state transitions using logistic adoption with persistence, social influence, information, and policy pressure.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  f_family = peer_frac_family[i,t-1]
  f_work = peer_frac_work[i,t-1]
  f_comm = peer_frac_community[i,t-1]
  age_mod = age_modifier(age_group[i])
  occ_mod = occ_modifier(occupation[i])
  peer_term = beta_peer_family*f_family + beta_peer_work_school*f_work + beta_peer_community*f_comm
  peer_term *= 0.5*(age_mod + occ_mod)
  logit_p = alpha_intercept + gamma_risk_perception*risk_perception[i] + delta_received_info*received_info[i] + phi_persistence*mask_wearing[i,t-1] + policy_pressure_coef * policy_pressure[i] + peer_term
  p_adopt = sigmoid(logit_p)
  if mask_wearing[i,t-1] == 1:
    drop = Bernoulli(dropout_prob * (1 - min(1.0, f_family*w_family + f_work*w_work_school + f_comm*w_community)))
    new_state = 0 if drop else 1
  else:
    new_state ~ Bernoulli(p_adopt)
  mask_wearing_desired[i,t] = new_state
notes: Layer weights w_* also reduce dropout when peer adoption is strong.
Effective peer fractions computed on undirected, symmetrized layers.

modules.calibration_notes: Stage-1: initialize coefficients from micro-logistic regressions; Stage-2: refine via CMA-ES minimizing weighted RMSE/MAE and penalties on peak/time-to-50/final; constraints keep probabilities in bounds.

modules.name: SupplyAndPurchase
modules.description: Handles mask inventory, retailer restocking, and purchase attempts to satisfy desired adoption.

notes: Retailer price can be static or adjusted by stock pressure; defaults static.
Purchase occurs post-decision; lacking inventory can block adoption.

modules.calibration_notes: Supply parameters weakly identified by provided data; keep conservative defaults, optionally tune in macro fit.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates individual states to daily observables for calibration and evaluation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily[t] = mean_i(mask_wearing[i,t]) + Normal(0, observation_noise_std)
info_rate_daily[t] = mean_i(received_info[i,t])
adoption_rate_by_age_daily[t,g] = mean_{i in age_group g}(mask_wearing[i,t])
adoption_rate_by_occupation_daily[t,o] = mean_{i in occupation o}(mask_wearing[i,t])
notes: Observation noise is optional; default 0.0 for direct comparability.

modules.calibration_notes: Provides signals used by metrics and SBI for other modules.

algorithms.logistic_adoption: Sigmoid(alpha + gamma*risk + betas*peer_fracs + delta*info + phi*prev + policy_coef*policy_pressure)
algorithms.discrete_hazard_info: 1 - product over neighbors of (1 - p_layer * I(neighbor_informed) * mobility) combined with media hazard
algorithms.CMAES_calibrator: Simulation-based optimizer minimizing weighted loss over RMSE/MAE and penalties for peak/time-to-50/final
algorithms.network_construction: Read multiplex JSON, symmetrize per layer, build adjacency lists and precompute neighbor sets
algorithms.exposure_features: For each agent-day (t-1), compute peer_mask_fraction per layer as the mean of neighbors’ mask_wearing
